testcase.name: an out-of-range elevation is refused by code rather than by exception()
the boundary is the solver's own horizon turned into a latitude()
a site just below the boundary is accepted, north and south()
raw input failures each get their own code rather than one blanket refusal()
an already-built GeoLocation above the limit is rejected too()
the polar limit is checked before the zone, so the real reason is the one reported()
a site above the boundary is rejected with a reason a user can be told()
midnight sun is a dynamic fact about the site, not a fixed latitude()
a refusal is serialisable, so the API can return it rather than reword it()
